description: The lights of the church for the modern lighting (rt_lights, docs/RENDER.md section 10). By day: the sun through the open door and windows, the sky over the yard. The roof keeps the sun to the door and the windows; the yard (other cells) stays open.

sun.description: The overcast sun behind the fog: one fixed direction for the whole location (direction is the way the light travels, PS1 axes, y down). The fog dims it with the distance from the eye, so its shadows are only crisp near Harry and the fog keeps its own soft colour; light passes through the gaps of fences and leaves (alpha holes of the textures).

ceilings.description: The roof of the church (cell 0, 0): the nave draws no ceiling and its walls end at about 5.1 m, so without it the sun fell onto the pews from above.

sky.description: The grey sky's light on surfaces open to it: the bounce rays that find nothing above see it.
